discrepancies.description: The invoice from Apex Logistics Ltd. is missing a contractually required service level credit. The contract mandates that if the supplier's on-time delivery rate falls below 97% in any calendar month, a credit equal to 12% of that month's total invoice must be issued. For the billing period, performance did not meet this threshold, which should have resulted in a credit of $2,940.00. The invoice did not apply this credit, leading to an overpayment.
discrepancies.clause_text: Should the Supplier's on-time delivery rate fall below 97% in any calendar month, the Supplier shall issue a credit equal to 12% of that month's invoice total.
discrepancies.critic_reasoning: The contractual interpretation is sound. The rule unambiguously requires a 12% credit on the total monthly invoice if on-time delivery targets are missed. The calculated expected cost correctly represents this credit, and the discrepancy arises because the supplier did not issue it.
